title: Resident Services Desk Guidance: The Gas True-Up Line on Utility Services Program Accounts
content:
# The Gas True-Up Line — Utility Services Program

**What the line is.** On a Utility Services Program account that bills natural gas by submeter, the gas true-up line is the gas usage line of the billing period closed by an actual gas read that follows one or more estimated gas reads. It is issued at the first bill issue after that actual read, and it is owed from that bill issue day until it stands on the account.

**What it governs.** The line settles the gas usage of that billing period against the gas usage already billed on the estimated gas lines, and it carries the amount billed for that period. Once posted, it appears among the account's bill lines, marked as resting on an actual read, and the account's outstanding utility balance rises by its amount.

## Recording the line: `post_gas_trueup_line_465c860d`

The line is recorded by the resident services agent. The agent first unlocks the tool `post_gas_trueup_line_465c860d` and then calls it. One call records one new gas usage line dated today, marked as resting on an actual read, with the therms billed and the amount billed, and raises the account's outstanding utility balance by that amount. The tool computes nothing and checks no condition: the period, the therms and the amount it receives are the figures the agent has already worked out.

### Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `utility_account_id` | the reference number of the resident's utility services account the line is posted on, as returned by the utility account lookup | identifier |
| `billing_period` | the service month the gas line bills, for example the month closed by the actual gas read | `YYYY-MM` |
| `usage_quantity` | the gas usage the line bills, in therms | decimal with up to 3 places; recorded rounded to 3 decimal places |
| `amount` | the amount the line bills, in US dollars | 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent; zero or positive |

### Return

When the line has been posted the tool returns a receipt with these keys:

- `status` — the string "posted";
- `bill_id` — the reference number of the new gas usage line;
- `billing_period` — the service month billed, `YYYY-MM`;
- `usage_quantity` — the therms billed, 3 decimal places;
- `amount` — the amount billed, 2 decimal places;
- `balance_due` — the account's outstanding utility balance after the line, 2 decimal places.

### Illustration of a call (hypothetical values)

A call with `utility_account_id` set to the account's reference number, `billing_period` "2026-05", `usage_quantity` 41.25 and `amount` 64.10 returns `status` "posted", a new `bill_id`, the same period, `usage_quantity` 41.25, `amount` 64.10 and the account's new `balance_due`. The values here show the format only.
